Bihar-Jharkhand Earthquake: munger se bari khabar... mangalvar subah bhukanp ke halke jhatke mahsus kie gae... jhatka kaphi kam tivrata ka aur mahaj 2 se 3 sekand tak raha... achanak dharti men kanpan mahsus hone se logon men dahshat phaili... kaee log apne gharon se nikalkar khule sthanon ki or aa gae...
